## Is your feature request related to a problem? 
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: I am always frustrated when [...]

## The Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

[Image of a UI mockup or flowchart]
 (If relevant and optional but helpful!)

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered (e.g., using a different tool, a manual workaround).

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. Does this impact performance? Are there security considerations?

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this has not been requested before.
- [ ] This is a single, focused feature request (not a "bundle" of ideas).
